The Patagonia Black Hole Pack 25L has the features you're looking for in a hiking daypack, the reputation of being manufactured by one of the industry's leaders in outdoor clothing and gear, and an enticing discount of 50% off.

REI is now selling the Patagonia Black Hole Pack 25L for just $77, half off the original price of $155. The sale is only for the noble grey colorway.

The daypack is 25 liters in size, and its dimensions mean it meets most airlines' requirements for being allowed as a carry-on. The main compartment includes a padded sleeve in case you want to carry your computer – it can fit most 15-inch laptops – or protect other valuables. There are other pockets both inside and outside of the backpack, including a stretch-woven pocket designed for various water bottle sizes.

All of which makes this a good backpack whether you are on the trails or just want something comfortable, durable, and reliable for your daily life.

With more than 50 ratings, REI shoppers have given this hiking daypack an average of 4.4 stars out of 5 so far. Here's what some customers have had to say:

  • "I have used it as a travel bag several times, taken it with me on hikes, and bike/train commute with it to work every day. It has held up great. It's very stylish, and the daisy chains on the back are useful for bike helmets, climbing shoes/chalk bags, etc."

  • "This bag is excellent. Lots of space for being so small. Various compartments and zippers make organizing easy. Comfortable straps. Durable. Just an overall fantastic bag."

REI Clearance Sale Pricing: 25-Liter Hiking Daypack for 50% Off

Small but mighty, the Patagonia Black Hole Pack 25L fits what you need for a day on the trails or your daily life – and it's an even better fit in your life right now thanks to REI's clearance sale price of $77, 50% off the original price of $155.

This item qualifies for free standard shipping. REI's policy allows for returns within one year of purchase for REI Co-op Members or within 90 days for non-members.
